title: Design System: Sprint — Crisp Navy Playbook

narrative.overview: Sprint's interface is a clean, light workspace — the same shade family as the product's reference app: light cool-gray ground, white cards, slate-navy ink, navy primary actions, and one brighter royal-blue accent carrying highlights. Machinery is shown, not decorated around: boards move, queues retry, connectors draw.
keyCharacteristics: Light theme only. Depth comes from hairline borders and soft navy-tinted shadows, never dark surfaces.
The accent (#3B82F6) is the brightest thing on the page and stays in the navy shade family.
Monospace is reserved for measurements, file names, and spec names — never as a "technical" costume.
Motion is calm but alive: the hero's light-mode WebGL ocean is the single authored moment; everything else reveals once and settles.
Honesty is visual too: sample data is labeled, claims are real, no invented proof.

rules.rule: The Same-Shade Rule. Every color on the page belongs to the reference app's navy/slate family. New colors must be siblings of navy #314C81 or slate #242E42 — never foreign hues. Semantic amber (retry states in illustrative data) is the sole exception.

dos: Keep every color inside the navy/slate family
Use mono for measurements and spec names
donts: Introduce foreign hues or revert to dark surfaces
